casual2.scene: At a quiet rooftop thermal pool after swimming, she sits cross-legged on a dry broad cedar bench and leans back slightly to watch large floating soap bubbles drifting above the water. A small cream antler-shaped bubble wand rests in a ceramic tray beside the bench, and two dark round floats bob on the pool. Her own right forearm extends down to the bench beside her right hip, palm resting flat; her left arm bends forward with the open hand held at chest height to catch a bubble. Both arms are clear of her torso. Three-quarter body toward the camera, face turned toward the bubble, a knee-up composition at eye height. She wears an original sea-glass turquoise swimsuit: two opaque sculpted scallop-edge bust cups held by a broad folded collar-like yoke, and a separate secure high-waisted bottom with a diagonal fan-pleated hip fin; open waist and shoulders, full chest and pelvis coverage. As she leans back and unfolds her legs to stand, the diagonal hip fin fans outward, briefly showing the bare upper outer thigh beneath its decorative extension; the secure swimsuit base remains fixed. This is a deliberate pose and articulated garment detail, not wind, water-soaked cloth, a slipping strap, undone fastenings or a wardrobe failure.

casual8.scene: On a sunny suburban miniature-golf course, she has just sent a ball into an optical-illusion spiral putting hole and celebrates the surprising result with a playful wink. A large black-and-white concentric-circle target is built into the putting green behind her, recalling her affinity for visual illusions without literal magic. She stands with her weight on her left leg and her right knee relaxed; her own right arm extends naturally downward holding a single putter with its head on the turf, her own left arm bends in front with a loose small celebratory fist near her left shoulder. Each arm is visibly connected and has one task. Full body from a slightly elevated natural viewpoint, face toward camera, green and flowering hedges around her. She wears an original lilac fitted wrap-front sports crop top with a folded petal-shaped lapel and two short capped sleeves, a narrow open band of bare midriff, and a pleated asymmetrical skort with one elongated overlapping front panel, opaque fitted shorts underneath, ankle socks and plain trainers. A single tiny cream antler earring is her only species accessory; outfit colours are lilac and dark teal, not the reference armor palette.
